items.name: Strength
items.description: Strength is the measure of your physical power and might.

items.name: Dexterity
items.description: Dexterity is the measure of your agility, reflexes, and balance.

items.name: Constitution
items.description: Constitution is the measure of your health, stamina, and resilience.

items.name: Intelligence
items.description: Intelligence is the measure of your reasoning, memory, and analytical skill.

items.name: Wisdom
items.description: Wisdom is the measure of your perception, intuition, and insight.

items.name: Charisma
items.description: Charisma is the measure of your force of personality, persuasiveness, and leadership.

items.name: Vigor
items.description: Vigor measures your connection to dark — the resource that powers the Ultramodern5 (DARK) magic system. Optional; only used in games with magic.
